answer: Two leasing companies changed their third-party buyout terms on February 1, 2026. Crescent Motor Credit went from not allowing third-party buyouts to allowing them. Apex Lease Co already allowed them and still does, but since that date it adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount. No other leasing company's rules changed on that date: Summit Auto Lease still allows buyouts, Bluewater Leasing allows them only if the customer also buys a car from Northwind, and Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow them.
